# Advanced Alchemy

> A carefully crafted, thoroughly tested, optimized companion library for SQLAlchemy.

Full documentation corpus: https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/llms-full.txt

## Overview & Getting Started

- [Advanced Alchemy](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/): Advanced Alchemy is a carefully crafted, thoroughly tested, optimized companion library for SQLAlchemy.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/getting-started.html): Advanced Alchemy is a carefully crafted, thoroughly tested, optimized companion library for SQLAlchemy.
- [Usage](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/index.html): This guide demonstrates building a complete blog system using Advanced Alchemy’s features. We’ll create a system that supports:

## Usage Guides

- [Modeling](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/index.html): Advanced Alchemy enhances SQLAlchemy’s modeling capabilities with production-ready base classes, mixins, and specialized types.
- [Modeling Basics](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/basics.html): Advanced Alchemy extends SQLAlchemy 2.0’s declarative mapping with opinionated base classes, composable primary-key and audit mixins, and deterministic physical column ordering.
- [Inheritance Patterns](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/inheritance.html): Advanced Alchemy provides robust support for SQLAlchemy’s inheritance patterns, ensuring that mixins and common attributes are correctly applied across the hierarchy.
- [SQLModel Integration](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/sqlmodel.html): Advanced Alchemy provides built-in compatibility for SQLModel, allowing you to use SQLModel’s elegant syntax for defining models while leveraging Advanced Alchemy’s powerful repositories and services.
- [Advanced Types](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/types.html): Advanced Alchemy provides dialect-adaptive SQLAlchemy column types in advanced_alchemy.types with strict Python type annotations. Security and file storage types are covered in Security and File Storage Types.
- [Security and File Storage Types](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/security_and_storage_types.html): Advanced Alchemy provides column types for field-level encryption, one-way password hashing, TOTP multi-factor enrollment, single-use verification codes, and backend-agnostic file storage.
- [Repositories](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/repositories/index.html): Advanced Alchemy’s repository pattern provides a clean, consistent interface for database operations.
- [Repository Basics](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/repositories/basics.html): Advanced Alchemy’s repository pattern provides a consistent, type-safe interface for database operations that abstracts SQLAlchemy session and query construction.
- [Filtering and Pagination](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/repositories/filtering.html): Advanced Alchemy provides a powerful and flexible system for filtering and paginating your database queries.
- [Advanced Repository](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/repositories/advanced.html): This section covers advanced repository features including composite primary keys and row locking.
- [Services](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/services.html): Services in Advanced Alchemy wrap repositories to coordinate business rules, lifecycle hooks, pagination, and schema conversion across Pydantic, msgspec, attrs / cattrs, dataclasses, and SQLModel.
- [Read/Write Routing](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/routing.html): Advanced Alchemy routes write operations (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) to a primary engine group while distributing read queries across replica engine groups.
- [Caching](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/caching.html): Advanced Alchemy integrates with dogpile.cache to provide second-level (L2) entity and query caching with transaction-aware invalidation and singleflight stampede protection.
- [Command Line Tool](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/cli.html): Advanced Alchemy provides a standalone command-line interface (alchemy) for database migrations, schema initialization, table dumps, and configuration inspection. Full option tables for every command are generated aut...
- [CLI Command Workflows](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/cli_commands.html): This guide walks through common database lifecycle workflows using the standalone alchemy CLI (or litestar database / flask database when using web framework integrations). Complete flag signatures for every subcomman...
- [Database Seeding and Fixture Loading](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/database_seeding.html): Advanced Alchemy provides open_fixture() and open_fixture_async() for loading JSON and CSV fixtures from disk (including .gz and .zip archives).
- [Litestar Integration](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/litestar.html): Advanced Alchemy provides first-class integration with Litestar through SQLAlchemyPlugin, which re-exports core models, repositories, services, filters, and data transfer objects under advanced_alchemy.extensions.lite...
- [Litestar Database and Server Sessions](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/litestar_sessions.html): Advanced Alchemy manages both request-scoped SQLAlchemy database sessions and database-backed server-side HTTP sessions for Litestar applications.
- [Litestar File and Object Storage](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/litestar_storage.html): Advanced Alchemy integrates declarative file and object storage with Litestar via StoredObject, FileObject, and the global storages registry.
- [Flask Integration](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/flask.html): Advanced Alchemy integrates with Flask through AdvancedAlchemy, managing application-context sessions, synchronous and asynchronous SQLAlchemy configurations, and Flask CLI database migration commands.
- [FastAPI Integration](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/fastapi.html): Advanced Alchemy integrates with FastAPI through AdvancedAlchemy, providing engine lifecycle management, request-scoped SQLAlchemy sessions, service and filter dependency generators, and CLI migration commands.
- [FastAPI File Storage and Multi-Binds](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/fastapi_storage.html): Advanced Alchemy’s StoredObject and FileObject types integrate with FastAPI multipart form uploads and Pydantic computed fields.
- [Sanic Integration](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/sanic.html): Advanced Alchemy integrates with Sanic through AdvancedAlchemy (a sanic-ext Extension), managing engines on app.ctx, request-scoped sessions on request.ctx, dependency injection via sanic-ext, and bind-key lookups for...
- [Starlette Integration](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/starlette.html): Advanced Alchemy integrates with Starlette through AdvancedAlchemy, which initializes SQLAlchemy configurations, manages request-scoped sessions on request.state, and exposes engine and session accessors for route han...

## API Reference

- [API Reference](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/index.html): The API reference provides detailed documentation for all public classes, functions, and modules in Advanced Alchemy. Each section includes complete type information, usage examples, and links to related documentation.
- [base](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/base.html): Documentation for base.
- [mixins](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/index.html): Mixins that provide common columns and behavior for SQLAlchemy models.
- [unique](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/unique.html): Documentation for unique.
- [nanoid](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/nanoid.html): Documentation for nanoid.
- [uuid](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/uuid.html): Documentation for uuid.
- [sentinel](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/sentinel.html): Documentation for sentinel.
- [bigint](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/bigint.html): Documentation for bigint.
- [audit](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/audit.html): Documentation for audit.
- [slug](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/slug.html): Documentation for slug.
- [config](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/index.html): API Reference for the Config module
- [asyncio](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/asyncio.html): Documentation for asyncio.
- [common](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/common.html): Documentation for common.
- [engine](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/engine.html): Documentation for engine.
- [routing](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/routing.html): Configuration classes for read/write replica routing.
- [sync](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/sync.html): Sync SQLAlchemy configuration module.
- [types](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/types.html): Type aliases and constants used in the package config.
- [cache](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/cache.html): Dogpile L2 caching integration for SQLAlchemy repositories with commit-aware invalidation and per-process singleflight protection.
- [operations](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/operations.html): Documentation for operations.
- [types](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/types.html): Documentation for types.
- [exceptions](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/exceptions.html): Exception hierarchy and SQLAlchemy error translation utilities converting low-level driver errors such as sqlalchemy.exc.IntegrityError and sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError into typed domain exceptions.
- [cli](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/cli.html): Command-line interface and migration commands for Advanced Alchemy.
- [utils](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/utils.html): Documentation for utils.
- [repositories](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/repository.html): Documentation for repositories.
- [memory repositories](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/repository_memory.html): Documentation for memory repositories.
- [filters](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/filters.html): Documentation for filters.
- [services](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/service.html): Documentation for services.
- [routing](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/routing.html): Read/write replica session routing for SQLAlchemy engines and sessions. See RoutingConfig, ReplicaConfig, and RoutingStrategy for configuration.
- [Extensions](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/index.html): API Reference for the advanced_alchemy.extensions package.
- [litestar](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/index.html): Litestar framework integration providing plugins, session lifecycle handlers, dependency injection providers, DTOs, server-side session backends, and CLI commands.
- [dto](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/dto.html): Documentation for dto.
- [plugin](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/plugins.html): Documentation for plugin.
- [cli](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/cli.html): Litestar CLI database group and plugin discovery utilities.
- [Session Backends](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/session.html): This module provides SQLAlchemy-based session backends for Litestar’s server-side session middleware.
- [Store](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/store.html): This module provides a SQLAlchemy-backed implementation of Litestar’s Store protocol. Register a SQLAlchemyStore under the "sessions" store name to back Litestar’s server-side session middleware with your SQLAlchemy d...
- [flask](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/flask/index.html): API Reference for the Flask extensions module.
- [sanic](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/sanic/index.html): API Reference for the Sanic extensions module.
- [starlette](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/starlette/index.html): API Reference for the Starlette extensions module.
- [fastapi](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/fastapi/index.html): API Reference for the FastAPI extensions module.
- [alembic](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/alembic/index.html): API Reference for the Alembic module
- [commands](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/alembic/commands.html): Documentation for commands.
- [utils](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/alembic/utils.html): Documentation for utils.

## Project & Changelog

- [1.x Changelog](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/changelog.html): Repository.upsert_many and Service.upsert_many now dispatch to the most efficient native upsert primitive supported by the active dialect when match_fields maps to a primary key, unique constraint, or unique index: IN...
- [Contribution guide](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/contribution-guide.html): 1. Run make install-uv to install uv if not already installed 1. Run make install to install all dependencies and pre-commit hooks
- [Advanced Alchemy Releases](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/releases.html): This library follows the Semantic Versioning standard, using the <major>.<minor>.<patch> schema:
